verses.gurmukhi: ੧੧ : ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਅੰਨੵ ਦੇਸ਼ੀ ਤੇ ਅੰਨੵ ਧਰਮੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਚਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 11 : gur sikh a(n)naye dheshee te a(n)naye dharameeaa(n) to(n) uchaa hai

en.bdb: Gursikh is above other indigenous and foreign religions

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੀ ਸੀਅ ਰਾਫਜੀ ਮਜਹਬ ਮਨ ਭਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: bahu su(n)nee seea raafajee majahab man bhaane|

en.bdb: Many people are there of attractive sects of Sunnis, Sias and Rafazts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਹਿਦ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਨਾਫਕਾ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ।
verses.translit_en: mulahidh hoi munaafakaa sabh bharam bhulaane|

en.bdb: Many hypocrites becoming atheists and deluded by illusions go on wandering here and there.
Followers of Jesus and Moses are also many who are confounded in their own pride.
Some are blackclad recluses and dervishes wearing bunches of cowaries
Around their arms who move about here and there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਹਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh rom na pujanee gur haT vikaane ||11||

en.bdb: They all are not equal to even a trichome of those Gursikhs who have sold themselves at the hands of the Guru.
